PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX marl: <http://www.gsi.upm.es/ontologies/marl/ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?emotionLabel (AVG(xsd:float(?polarityValue)) AS ?avgPolarityValue)
WHERE {
  ?lemma a lila:Lemma .
  ?emotionLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?lemma .
  ?emotionLexEntry elita:HasEmotion ?emotion .
  ?polarityLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?lemma .
  ?polarityLexEntry marl:hasPolarityValue ?polarityValue .
  ?emotion rdfs:label ?emotionLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?emotionLabel
HAVING (AVG(xsd:float(?polarityValue)) > 0)
ORDER BY DESC(?avgPolarityValue)

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?dialectWord) AS ?count)
WHERE {
    ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma .
    
    ?emotionEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    GRAPH <http://w3id.org/elita> {
        ?emotionEntry elita:HasEmotion ?emotion .
        ?emotion rdfs:label ?emotionLabel .
    }
    
    FILTER(STR(?emotionLabel) = "Rabbia")
    
    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?dialectLexEntry .
    ?dialectLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?dialectLemma .
    ?dialectLemma dcterms:isPartOf ?dialectLemmaBank .
    ?dialectLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?dialectWord .
    
    FILTER(regex(str(?dialectLemmaBank), "Dialetto", "i"))
}

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?italianWord ?parmigianoWord
WHERE {
    # Italian lemma with written representation
    ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                  ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    
    # Italian lexical entry
    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    
    # Translation to Parmigiano
    ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?parmigianoLexEntry .
    
    # Parmigiano lemma and written form
    ?parmigianoLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?parmigianoLemma .
    ?parmigianoLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoParmigiano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                     ontolex:writtenRep ?parmigianoWord .
    
    # Filter for the Italian word "pane"
    FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = "pane")
}

PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT ?italianWord ?sicilianWord
WHERE {
  # Find the Italian lemma with written representation 'figlio'
  ?italianLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
  FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = "figlio")
  
  # Find Italian lexical entry with this lemma as canonical form
  ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
  
  # Find Sicilian translation via vartrans:translatableAs
  ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?sicilianLexEntry .
  
  # Get Sicilian lemma and its written representation
  ?sicilianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?sicilianLemma .
  ?sicilianLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                 ontolex:writtenRep ?sicilianWord .
}

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?lemma (COUNT(DISTINCT ?sense) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    ?word ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?lemma ] .
    ?word ontolex:sense ?sense .
    FILTER(REGEX(STR(?lemma), "^(punto|capo|fine)$", "i"))
  }
}
GROUP BY ?lemma
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

# Retrieve emotions associated with Italian words and their average negative Sentix polarity scores, grouped by emotion type.

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>                     # LiITA ontology prefix for lemmas
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>                                # ELIta ontology prefix for emotion annotations
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>                 # OntoLex-Lemon vocabulary prefix for lexical entries
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>                  # RDFS standard vocabulary for labels
PREFIX marl: <http://www.gsi.upm.es/ontologies/marl/ns#>              # Sentix 3.0 ontology prefix for polarity annotations

SELECT ?emotionLabel (AVG(?polarityValue) AS ?avgPolarityValue) (COUNT(?lemma) AS ?count)  # Select emotion labels, average polarity values, and count
WHERE {
  ?lemma a lila:Lemma .                                               # Find resources typed as Lemma in LiITA (core lexical unit)
  ?emotionLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?lemma .                         # Link ELIta lexical entry to LiITA lemma as its canonical form
  ?emotionLexEntry elita:HasEmotion ?emotion .                            # Get any emotion associated with the lemma in ELIta
  ?emotion rdfs:label ?emotionLabel .                                     # Obtain the human-readable label of the emotion
  ?polarityLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?lemma .                        # Link Sentix lexical entry to same LiITA lemma for polarity info
  ?polarityLexEntry marl:hasPolarityValue ?polarityValue .                # Retrieve the numeric polarity value from Sentix
  FILTER(?polarityValue < 0)                                          # Filter for negative polarity scores only
}
GROUP BY ?emotionLabel                                                # Group results by emotion type
ORDER BY ASC(?avgPolarityValue)                                            # Order by average polarity (most negative first)

SELECT ?hypernymWord

    ?word ontolex:sense ?sense .

                  ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?hypernymWord ] .

}

}

# This query retrieves the definition(s) of the Italian lemma "terra" from the CompL-it resource in the LiITA knowledge base using OntoLex-Lemon structures.

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>  # OntoLex namespace for linguistic ontologies, including Lemmas, Forms, and Senses
PREFIX lime: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/lime#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>  # SKOS used here for definitions attached to senses
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?definition  # Select the definition linked to the sense of the lemma "terra"
WHERE {
    SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {  # Query the CompL-it specific endpoint within LiITA

            ?word ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord ] ;  # ?word is a lexical entry with a canonical written form ?italianWord

                    ontolex:sense [ skos:definition ?definition ] .  # The lexical entry has one or more senses that have definitions

        FILTER ( STR(?italianWord) = "terra" ) .  # Filter lexical entries whose canonical form is exactly "terra"
  }
}
  # Limit results to at most 10 definitions

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>

PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?writtenRep ?definition
WHERE {
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    ?word ontolex:sense [ skos:definition ?definition ] ;
          ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?writtenRep ] .
    FILTER(REGEX(?definition, "terra", "i"))
  }
}

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX lime: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/lime#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?italianWord ?parmigianoWord
WHERE {
    ?italianLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    
    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ;
                     vartrans:translatableAs ?parmigianoLexEntry .
    
    ?parmigianoLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?parmigianoLemma .
    ?parmigianoLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoParmigiano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                     ontolex:writtenRep ?parmigianoWord .
    
    FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = "pane")
}
